turns.text: She said, "I was wondering if maybe you could help me."
turns.zh: 她说：「我在想，也许你能不能帮我一下。」

turns.text: It just shows how common that phrase is.
turns.zh: 这恰恰说明这个说法有多常见。
好，现在到了棘手的地方。

turns.text: We need to talk about how Tom said no.
turns.zh: 我们得聊聊 Tom 是怎么说不的。

turns.text: Yeah, it's not easy to say no, right?
turns.zh: 是啊，说不并不容易，对吧？

turns.text: You don't want to be rude.
Tom said, "I'm so sorry, but I can't.
turns.zh: Tom 说：「非常抱歉，但我不能。」
